notes.title: 1.2.1 Patch
notes.notes:
1.2.1 Patch


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111025/efae8a19ab111f0d8b3f449e78e74e4a1fe1c7cd.png"]


9-Shot
A leftover weapon previously exclusive to Randomizer, the 9-Shot can now be unlocked by beating Classic!


General:
Added “Area” stat to weapons in the Equipment menu

Added music tracks from Classic and Randomizer to Endless mode


Fixes:
Fixed invisible beam bug in Randomizer and added failsafe to delete a beam if it lasts too long

Fixed dying players causing a softlock during escape

Game would only check to leave whenever someone enters the ship, now also checks when a player dies

notes.title: The Musical Update
notes.notes:
1.2 - The Musical Update


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111025/12f6ee2b54c03bb662fe91fc6efddaa6527b8e3d.png"]

Jukebox

New Jukebox menu in Collection

Listen to songs from the game!

Each song features a unique album cover!

Purchase songs from the Extras store

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111025/584e1ce272e3a9a1d39d10fc8ae00033155502a4.png"]



20 New Tracks

New music for Randomizer, Boss Rush, and idle themes!



Double Bosses

Added double bosses to Boss Rush on wave 5 and 10

Fight two bosses at the same time!

Doubled bosses have less health, but are just as dangerous!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111025/1155435c5a75ace2609576109b822878ab9f0d9e.png"]
Fixes:
Fixed a crash when using turrets against the Groath boss (thanks Pynus44th!)

(Hopefully) fixed railgun missing

Fixed Ralbo not being discoverable in the Bestiary

Fixed Ultramine retriggering and delaying its explosion
Tweaks:
Reduced time for Ralien Tank to begin shooting mines at half health

Ralien Mine fuse reduction (5s -> 4s)

Increased wander range for Stronghold

Reduced Nautilaur attack speed (1.5s -> 2s)

Doubled plasma bomb explosion area (40 px diameter -> 80 px diameter)

notes.title: The Cheevo Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111025/cc8da87514b954f24091fa6449a858a84791bfac.png

1.1 - The Cheevo Update

Achievements
16 new Steam Achievements to earn!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111025/c82f5fd5c7972075a54b0baae972920b12f580b8.png

Background Customization

 You can now choose backgrounds regardless of gamemode!
 New Customization menu (available in Collection)
 Multiple backgrounds can be selected and will be picked at random each playthrough
 Gamemode-specific backgrounds become available when said mode is unlocked

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111025/ccf508b5020d92f44125760f1dc6249ee50f62af.png

New Maps
With choice comes choices! These maps can be purchased in the Store.

Beveled
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111025/9a5e2e9ed043e42bde17250de99bd11e041c3261.png

Forest
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111025/6f07ab6ed3cade0937d7077d00e7e2f75ce18b7c.png

Cobalt
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111025/b3da9a26f1ae6ff8e138905d59ee09bb17d9674b.png

New Rocks

 Debris created by explosions and impacts now match the ground they come from
 Yes this was very necessary!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111025/096d79d0f13125016b11177d9b93496697d59868.png

Controller Remapping
You can now edit controller bindings for each player in the settings!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111025/c7190e5b312a69f0acb8399ab369be4892fcf9ee.png


Fixes:

 Fixed text clipping in the mode select
 Fixed a potential crash involving homing projectiles and aiming enemies


Tweaks:

 Updated credits
 Made Wave 9 slightly easier
 Increased Burst Launcher direct damage (5 -> 7)
 Decreased Burst Rifle firing speed (1.05s -> 1.25s)
 Tweaked Wave 9 to be more interesting and a little easier
 Antillery HP decrease (15 -> 12)
 Tallbug HP decrease (34 -> 28)
 Big Groath move speed decrease

Tankbug rework

 Updated art
 Shoot speed decrease (2.5s -> 3s)
 Can now jump to first platform
 Can now angle shots to hit players from above or below

notes.title: 1.0.2 Patch
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111025/1ee4ea2dff638662e09b71c38f413069de071bf1.png
Additions:

 Added a basic help section on the main menu that becomes available after completing the tutorial
 Added strafing to the tutorial 
(Hold the A key or right bumper while moving. You will not change direction!)
 Added a YouTube link to Credits


Fixes:

 Fixed missing selection sound for mode select
 Collection screen music should now loop
 Fixed missing Blork tooth
 Fixed idle music not changing between maps
 Fixed a potential softlock with a wave 10 boss


Balancing:

 Decreased attack speed of some late game enemies
 Increased hurtbox size on some enemies, making them easier to hit
 Medkit now drops 3 health items instead of 2
 Medkit now instantly revives players to full health instead of half
 Free throwables in late game now drop in a greater radius
 Bertha rocket health no longer scales to player count

notes.title: 1.0.1 Patch
notes.notes:
General

 Fixed backgrounds not changing from the default one
 Fixed mode select desyncing and becoming offset
 Fixed wins not being saved
 Fixed gamemodes not appearing as unlocked when freshly opening the game
 Fixed throwable pickups making wrong sound in multiplayer
 Fixed incorrect portrait in Bestiary
 Escape sequence difficulty now scales to player count
 Ralien Tank health increased from 120 to 140


Bug Bertha

 Fixed a strange bug where mid-air babies could be knocked far away and cause a softlock
 Now drops health instead of armor when hit with grenades

Nautilaur

 Tweaked beam attack animation and duration

Randomizer

 Added a sound effect for when weapons switch
 Fixed some gun sounds persisting after weapon switch

Endless

 Highest wave reached is now shown on mode select

notes.title: SPASE DEFENSE Release
notes.notes:
The game is finally out! 

It's been a wild 4 years. Thank you to everybody who played and gave feedback during development!

Expect updates in the near future!


P.S. If you've played the demo, your progress should carry over to the main game!

Snag a 10% discount until Nov 26!
